faq.title: Have questions
faq.text: Need help with a ticket or attending an event? Write to us and we will point you in the right direction.

1.a: It is a platform for discovering forums and other events in Kyrgyzstan, finding event details, and getting tickets online.

2.q: How do I register for an event?
2.a: Choose an event from the calendar, open its page, and follow the instructions for the ticket type you want. Keep your digital ticket after checkout.

3.q: How do I use my digital ticket?
3.a: Show the ticket's QR code at the entrance. The organizer will scan it when checking in attendees.

4.q: What if I have a question about an event?
4.a: Email us at the address shown on this page. We can help find the information you need or point you to the event organizer.
